lines.en: Sergeant Barnabas, we've got another one. Get your men organized and ready to deploy in two hours.
lines.zh: 巴纳巴斯军士，我们又找到一个圣殿。两个小时内将你的士兵组织起来准备出动。

lines.en: ...Do you have a problem with that, Sergeant?
No, sir. The Army is being put to good use, sir.
lines.zh: 没有，大人。军队在执行的命令都是正当的，大人。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en:
...Yes, I'm sure you think so.
And try to clean the uniforms up a bit before your men shut that place down. The war's over. The public has eyes on everything we do.
With what resources, sir? We barely got enough coin to keep our boys from choppin' my head off in a mutiny as is. You tellin' me we're to worry about spit 'n polish now too?
lines.zh: 用什么清理呢，大人？我们的军饷也只够保证手底下的士兵不哗变把我的脑袋砍下来。结果你现在还要我们担心老百姓对我们的看法？
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en:
Just find a way, Sergeant. Put down that paperwork and do it your damn self if you have to.  We're all on tight budgets. Don't think my superiors haven't kicked me around lately. As you were.
I can do it, sir...
...Whoa there, small fry! Who let ya in here?
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: Hey, don't sweat it, kid! Get on home now, your folks are probably worried sick.
lines.zh: 嘿，别怕，孩子！快回家吧，你的家人可能担心坏了。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: Damn...  thought so. Was hopin' you had a home to go to.
lines.zh: 该死的…… 我猜也是。本来对你有家可回还抱有一丝希望。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: Please let me clean your uniforms, sir...
lines.zh: 让我清洗你们的军装吧，大人……

lines.en: I ain't got nothin' to pay ya, kiddo. It ain't worth spendin' the energy.
lines.zh: 我没有什么可以付给你的，孩子。不值得你白费精力。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.zh: 没关系…… 求您了大人……

lines.en: There's supplies in the basement. Maybe the shields could have a bit more shine to 'em.
lines.zh: 地下室里有军用物资。也许那些盾牌需要更锃亮些。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: ...Looks like I lost my appetite too. Guess someone'll have to take my lunch so it don't go bad. It's nothin' special but it fills ya up...
lines.zh: ……我好像也没有胃口了。要不让谁把我的午饭拿回去吧，不然就放坏了。这饭没什么特别的，不过管饱……
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯
